Name: Female Wizard - Sprite And Portrait
Author: CreepyKat
Description:
I never liked the way the wizard looked, so I turned him into a witch! ☆ I tried to keep this so that it would fit in with the vanilla style of the game :)

Changes:
Character Sprite
Character Portrait

The sprites were inspired by those featured in einari's female wizard mod.

Instructions:
. This mod replaces the original .xnb sprite and portrait files. Please make a backup of the original files if necessary!
. Unzip or extract the folder after downloading.
. Place the file under Character (wizard.xnb) into the Stardew Valley folder under Content\Characters and let it overwrite.
. Place the file under Portrait (wizard.xnb) into the Stardew Valley folder under Content\Portraits and let it overwrite.

Any issues, please let me know. Have fun! :3


*EDIT* There is now a mod to change the name from 'wizard' to 'witch' created by Novatius: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1031/?
There is also the option to change the dialogue to suit the female version, go check it out!
